description: Every setting file-hub reads at runtime.

database_url.description: SQLAlchemy database URL for the file-hub metadata database.
database_url.title: Database Url

storage_backend.description: Where uploaded file contents are stored: "local" or "s3".
storage_backend.title: Storage Backend

local_storage_path.description: Directory for uploaded files when storage_backend is "local".
local_storage_path.title: Local Storage Path

s3_endpoint.description: S3-compatible endpoint URL (leave empty for AWS S3).
s3_endpoint.title: S3 Endpoint

s3_bucket.description: S3 bucket name for uploaded files.
s3_bucket.title: S3 Bucket

s3_access_key.description: S3 access key (leave empty to use IAM role credentials).
s3_access_key.title: S3 Access Key

s3_region.description: AWS region of the S3 bucket.
s3_region.title: S3 Region

max_file_size.description: Maximum upload size in bytes (default 100 MB).
max_file_size.title: Max File Size

enrichment_llm_api_base.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible LLM API used for file enrichment.
enrichment_llm_api_base.title: Enrichment Llm Api Base

enrichment_llm_api_key.description: API key for the enrichment LLM API.
enrichment_llm_api_key.title: Enrichment Llm Api Key

enrichment_llm_timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds for LLM enrichment calls.
enrichment_llm_timeout.title: Enrichment Llm Timeout

enrichment_llm_max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens generated per LLM enrichment response.
enrichment_llm_max_tokens.title: Enrichment Llm Max Tokens

enrichment_llm_embedding_model.description: Embedding model served by enrichment_llm_api_base; must emit vectors matching EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS and the pgvector column.
enrichment_llm_embedding_model.title: Enrichment Llm Embedding Model

title: Settings
